Introducing Saved Views, available today for everyone on a paid plan. Saved Views lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you've set up on any list, so you never have to rebuild your perfect view from scratch. Set up a view once for sprint planning, bug triage, or weekly reporting, then return to it in a single click whenever you need it.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize views around projects, clients, or workflows. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters on their own. Shared views update automatically as your data changes, keeping every teammate looking at consistent, up-to-date information.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Whether you're managing a single project or coordinating across teams, this feature helps you spend less time configuring and more time getting work done.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
